problems.explain: Each side of △DEF joins two midpoints, so it is half the side of △ABC it is parallel to. Its perimeter is half of ABC’s: (15 + 29 + 24) ÷ 2 = 68 ÷ 2 = 34. (Each midsegment halves a different side: none of them is half of the side it touches.) So 34.

problems.explain: Each side of △DEF joins two midpoints, so it is half the side of △ABC it is parallel to. Its perimeter is half of ABC’s: (20 + 4 + 20) ÷ 2 = 44 ÷ 2 = 22. (Each midsegment halves a different side: none of them is half of the side it touches.) So 22.

problems.explain: Each side of △DEF joins two midpoints, so it is half the side of △ABC it is parallel to. Its perimeter is half of ABC’s: (25 + 15 + 28) ÷ 2 = 68 ÷ 2 = 34. (Each midsegment halves a different side: none of them is half of the side it touches.) So 34.
